AboutSection.description: For over 3 decades, Cargo Track Relocations has delivered premier relocation, freight, and logistics solutions across Saudi Arabia and worldwide. With major branches in Jeddah, Riyadh, and Dammam, we simplify international moves, corporate mobility, and storage through an end-to-end, stress-free approach.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide secure, tailored, and hassle-free relocation solutions backed by expert craftsmanship and global standards.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the regional leader in mobility, recognized for total reliability, safety, and worldwide logistics alliances.

AboutSection.strengthsTitle: Built for complete peace of mind

ServicesSection.introText: From seamless household moves and office relocations to specialized artwork handling, pet relocation, and deep cleaning, Cargotrack manages every detail with precision, care, and professionalism.

services.title: Home Shifting Services
services.description: End-to-end packing, furniture dismantling and assembly, safe transit, and room-by-room placement for apartments and villas.

steps.title: Quick Quote or Survey
steps.detail: Share your home size or item list to lock in a clear moving plan.

steps.title: Room-by-Room Packing
steps.detail: Cartons, bubble wrap, corner guards, and labeled boxes for every room.

steps.title: Careful Transit
steps.detail: Clean, well-maintained vehicles with balanced loading and protection.

steps.title: Unpack & Settle In
steps.detail: Furniture reassembled and boxes placed in their matching rooms.

highlights.label: Apartments & Villas
highlights.detail: Suited for compact flats, multi-bedroom homes, and family villas.

highlights.label: Furniture & Fragiles
highlights.detail: Wardrobes, beds, appliances, and glassware wrapped and handled with care.

highlights.label: Single-Team Accountability
highlights.detail: One coordinated crew from packing through setup—no juggling separate vendors.

faqs.q: Do you handle both packing and furniture assembly?
faqs.a: Yes. Our crew packs your items, moves them, and reassembles standard household furniture on arrival.

faqs.q: Can you move both apartments and large family villas?
faqs.a: Yes—we scale crew size, packing materials, and vehicle capacity to match your home size.

faqs.q: Will boxes be placed in the right rooms at delivery?
faqs.a: Yes. Items are labeled by room and placed in their designated spaces rather than dumped at the door.

services.title: Packers and Movers Services
services.description: Reliable packing, protective materials, balanced loading, secure transit, and organized unloading for stress-free moves. Our service covers Riyadh , Jeddah and Dammam Locally and Covers all major countries internatinally.

steps.title: Fast Quote or Survey
steps.detail: Message or request a quote with your pickup, drop-off, and item details.

steps.title: Protective Wrapping
steps.detail: Double-wall cartons, bubble wrap, foam sheets, and edge guards.

steps.title: Balanced Loading & Transit
steps.detail: Secure load distribution to prevent shifting or friction in transit.

steps.title: Organized Unloading
steps.detail: Methodical unloading and clean placement at your destination.

highlights.label: Packing Materials Supplied
highlights.detail: Double-wall boxes, stretch film, foam, edge protectors, and room labels.

highlights.label: Delicate & Everyday Items
highlights.detail: Extra protection for fragile pieces, kitchenware, electronics, and boxes.

highlights.label: Structured Door-to-Door Flow
highlights.detail: Clear labeling and orderly handling from pickup to final drop-off.

faqs.q: Do you provide the packing boxes and wrapping materials?
faqs.a: Yes—protective cartons, wrapping, and cushioning are supplied as part of our packing service.

faqs.q: How do you keep items organized during the move?
faqs.a: Cartons are marked by room and contents so loading and unloading stay orderly.

faqs.q: Do you offer both local and longer-distance moving?
faqs.a: Yes—we handle local city moves as well as intercity and broader regional relocations.

services.title: Furniture Shifting Services
services.description: Specialized dismantling, protective wrapping, safe loading, transport, and reassembly for home and office furniture.

steps.title: Dismantle & Hardware Care
steps.detail: Modular pieces disassembled and fittings bagged so nothing goes missing.

steps.title: Surface & Edge Protection
steps.detail: Padding, film, and corner guards on wood, glass, and upholstery.

steps.title: Braced Vehicle Transit
steps.detail: Secured inside the truck to prevent rubbing, tipping, or impact.

steps.title: Reassembly & Placement
steps.detail: Rebuilt accurately and positioned where you want each piece.

highlights.label: Bedroom & Living Pieces
highlights.detail: Beds, wardrobes, sofas, sectionals, dining sets, and TV units.

highlights.label: Office Furniture
highlights.detail: Desks, workstations, conference tables, and storage cabinets.

highlights.label: Finish & Joint Protection
highlights.detail: Helps prevent scratches, chipped edges, loose joints, and strain injuries.

faqs.q: Do you dismantle beds and wardrobes before moving them?
faqs.a: Yes—our crew disassembles eligible pieces before transit and reassembles them at the destination.

faqs.q: How do you protect delicate or large furniture pieces?
faqs.a: We wrap surfaces and edges in protective padding and film and brace loads securely in transit.

faqs.q: Can you shift just a few furniture pieces or full room sets?
faqs.a: Yes—whether you are moving specific items or full sets, we tailor the crew and truck to the load.

services.title: Warehouse and Storage Services
services.description: Flexible short-term and long-term storage with organized inventory handling and protected custody until delivery.

steps.title: Pack & Log Items
steps.detail: Belongings are packed, tagged, and recorded for clear tracking.

steps.title: Store by Duration
steps.detail: Flexible short- or long-term options for renovations, gaps, or travel.

steps.title: Maintain Orderly Custody
steps.detail: Kept cleanly arranged and separated from casual clutter or mishandling.

steps.title: Schedule Redelivery
steps.detail: Delivered back to your home or site whenever your timeline is ready.

highlights.label: Flexible Timelines
highlights.detail: Ideal between leases, during home renovations, or while abroad.

highlights.label: Household & Commercial
highlights.detail: Suited for furniture, personal boxes, seasonal stock, and equipment.

highlights.label: On-Demand Retrieval
highlights.detail: Coordinate pickup or redelivery when you have your new keys or space.

faqs.q: Can I store items for just a few weeks or several months?
faqs.a: Yes—we offer flexible short-term and long-term storage depending on your schedule.

faqs.q: What can I put into storage?
faqs.a: Household furniture, packed boxes, personal belongings, and commercial or business items.

faqs.q: How do I get my items back when I'm ready?
faqs.a: Simply reach out to schedule retrieval and delivery to your new address.

steps.title: Workspace Placement

steps.title: Route & Quote Setup

steps.title: Pre-Move Check & Docs

steps.title: Arrival & Handover

steps.title: Custom Crating & Wrap

steps.title: Handling-Ready Prep
steps.detail: Configured for local, regional, or export transit stress.

steps.title: Dispatch & Arrival
steps.detail: Designed to reduce impact, shifting, and on-site damage risk.

CargoJourneySection.description: From specialized packing and customs coordination to international air/ocean freight and destination doorstep setup, CargoTrack streamlines your entire moving journey.

originCard.title: Origin
points: Pre-Move Survey – Assessing your shipment and planning the move.
Professional Packing – Safe and secure packing of your belongings.
Freight Services – Reliable transportation from origin to destination.
Move Coordination – Managing and coordinating every step of the shipment.

destinationCard.title: Destination
points: Customs Clearance – Handling the required customs procedures and documentation.
Transportation – Safe delivery of your shipment to the final destination.
Offloading – Careful unloading of your belongings at the delivery location.
Unpacking – Unpacking and placing your items as required.
Furniture Assembly & Fixing – Reassembling furniture and other items at your new location.

WhyChooseSection.description: We go beyond moving shipments—we simplify your entire supply chain and relocation journey with industry-leading care, global coverage, and unyielding precision.

features.title: Uncompromising Security

features.title: Global Reach, Local Expertise

features.title: Time-Definite Delivery
features.desc: Optimized route planning and priority freight handling to ensure precise, on-time arrivals every time.

features.title: End-to-End Visibility
features.desc: Real-time tracking, proactive status updates, and transparent logistics management from pickup to placement.

features.title: Dedicated Moving Experts

features.title: Cost & Value Efficiency
